rlusd_xrp.rlusd_controls: Ripple issuer terms/configuration include blacklisting/freezing and trust-line clawback controls.

rlusd_xrp.demand: RLUSD/XRPL activity does not automatically create material XRP demand. C2FO Instant Pay names RLUSD as settlement asset; XRP bridge use, collateral and spot purchases remain unproven.
